validations.evidence: External RIDE control plane and local runtime bridge are separate catalog components.

Closed packaged action/receipt schemas, strict read-only health-probe parsing, and side-effect-free target, issuer-policy, scope, expiry, epoch, precondition, duplicate, and idempotency decisions remain covered.

Exact-wire-byte HMAC-SHA256 verification precedes strict parsing; a mode-0600 SQLite ledger binds idempotency key, action ID, and semantic fingerprint, restores in-progress actions and immutable correlated terminal receipts after restart, and rejects tampering, conflicts, nonterminal completion, and receipt identity mismatches. All 42 focused control-bridge tests and relevant pre-commit hooks passed.

A core-owned spawn worker materializes only for exact action/receipt v1, bridge-plane, process-isolated, IPC-only descriptors; it imports no bundle code and implements ready handshake, a single bounded request slot, timeout/failure cleanup, drain/stop, explicit restart, and runtime/epoch/state/receipt rechecks. Without a runtime health source it returns failed/RUNTIME_HEALTH_UNAVAILABLE rather than a false healthy result. All 12 executor tests and relevant pre-commit hooks passed.

A transport-agnostic local service composes authentication, admission, durable lookup/reservation, and execution. Terminal retries after expiry restore the prior receipt; in-progress duplicates, semantic conflicts, executor failures, and unauthenticated inputs remain non-mutating and do not re-execute. All 24 affected security/service tests and relevant pre-commit hooks passed.
No authenticated transport or concurrent request host, production key lifecycle, runtime-owned health/operation API, OS sandbox for non-core code, or mutating action exists.

blockers: Only the read-only health-probe contract, pure admission gate, local HMAC primitive, durable replay ledger, and fixed core process worker exist; no mutating runtime action is defined.
The fixed worker proves IPC/lifecycle behavior but has no runtime health source and intentionally reports RUNTIME_HEALTH_UNAVAILABLE.
Authentication is not connected to a transport and no production key provisioning, rotation, revocation, or secret-storage policy exists.
Default configured Bundle v1 startup still rejects process isolation and non-empty permissions; the fixed executor is available only through explicit policy and materialization.
rollback: Keep the bridge unconfigured; default runtime behavior remains independent of the external control plane.
